parsed.post: Massive improvement! Switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (all shards) and increasing DEPTH to 6 dropped val_bpb to 0.8626. This is the new best. Next, I'll experiment with the learning rate and batch size to see if we can squeeze more out of this higher-capacity model within the 5-minute limit.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 and halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144. With the higher DEPTH=6, I want to see if more optimizer steps with a more conservative learning rate lead to better convergence.
